title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #17

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the word Christian mean? (1 mark)
   A. A soldier
   B. A follower of Christ
   C. A rich person
   D. A priest

2. The Bible begins by telling us that God is: (1 mark)
   A. A farmer
   B. A teacher of the law
   C. The Creator of heaven and earth
   D. A king of Egypt

3. What does the word holy mean? (1 mark)
   A. Rich
   B. Pure and set apart for God
   C. Old
   D. Famous

4. Which action shows love? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring
   B. Hurting
   C. Teasing
   D. Sharing your lunch

5. Which of these is a Gospel? (1 mark)
   A. Psalms
   B. Romans
   C. John
   D. Acts

6. How much would Zacchaeus pay back to anyone he had cheated? (1 mark)
   A. Ten times
   B. Four times the amount
   C. Twice
   D. Half

7. Which verse says, "God is love"? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. 1 John 4:8
   D. Acts 11:26

8. Which of these is a sign of real repentance? (1 mark)
   A. Repeating the wrong
   B. Only saying sorry with words
   C. Making things right with those we wronged
   D. Hiding the wrong

9. Which action honours God with the body? (1 mark)
   A. Taking drugs
   B. Fighting
   C. Using bad words
   D. Keeping clean and eating well

10. Which action shows respect for a grandmother? (1 mark)
   A. Helping her to carry water
   B. Shouting at her
   C. Ignoring her greeting
   D. Laughing at her

11. Which verse tells us to speak truthfully to our neighbour? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. Luke 19:5
   C. John 3:16
   D. Ephesians 4:25

12. What does Luke 16:10 teach? (1 mark)
   A. Do not work
   B. Be greedy
   C. Money is evil
   D. Whoever is trusted with little can be trusted with much

13. Which statement about God and human beings is true? (1 mark)
   A. God has forgotten small children
   B. God knows only adults
   C. God knows only the leaders
   D. God knows each person by name

14. What does the seed grow into? (1 mark)
   A. A large tree
   B. A river
   C. A small flower
   D. A rock

15. What are the two greatest commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Work and rest
   B. Buy and sell
   C. Love God and love your neighbour
   D. Pray and fast

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Name two things that Zacchaeus promised to do after meeting Jesus. (2 marks)

17. Give two ways of helping a needy classmate. (2 marks)

18. Name two fruits of the Spirit and give an example of each. (2 marks)

19. Where were believers first called Christians? (2 marks)

20. Write John 3:16 in your own words and explain what it teaches. (4 marks)

21. State three ways of thanking God every day. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — A follower of Christ
   Christian means a follower of Christ.

2. C — The Creator of heaven and earth
   Genesis 1:1 tells us God created heaven and earth.

3. B — Pure and set apart for God
   Holy means pure and set apart.

4. D — Sharing your lunch
   Sharing is practical love.

5. C — John
   The four Gospels are Matthew, Mark, Luke and John.

6. B — Four times the amount
   He promised to pay back four times.

7. C — 1 John 4:8
   1 John 4:8 states that God is love.

8. C — Making things right with those we wronged
   Zacchaeus showed repentance by paying back.

9. D — Keeping clean and eating well
   Care for the body honours God.

10. A — Helping her to carry water
   Helping shows respect and care.

11. D — Ephesians 4:25
   Ephesians 4:25 says to put off falsehood.

12. D — Whoever is trusted with little can be trusted with much
   Faithfulness in small things matters.

13. D — God knows each person by name
   Isaiah 43:1 says that God calls His people by name.

14. A — A large tree
   The seed grew and became a tree.

15. C — Love God and love your neighbour
   Matthew 22:37-39.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Give half his possessions to the poor and pay back four times to anyone he cheated.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each promise.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Share a pencil or lunch, help with a lesson, welcome them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Love: sharing lunch; kindness: helping a friend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fruit with example.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Antioch (Acts 11:26).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Antioch and 1 for reference or the meaning.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: God loved the world so much that He gave His only Son so that everyone who believes in Him will not be lost but will have eternal life. It teaches God's love and the way to eternal life.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's love, 1 for giving Jesus, 1 for believing, 1 for eternal life.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Pray, sing songs of praise, worship at church, use His gifts well, write a thank-you note.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.
